title: Simultaneous analysis of approximate leave-one-out cross-validation and mean-field inference
abstract: arXiv:2501.02624v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Approximate Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation (ALO-CV) is a method that has been proposed to estimate the generalization error of a regularized estimator in the high-dimensional regime where dimension and sample size are of the same order, the so-called ``proportional regime''. A new analysis is developed to derive the consistency of ALO-CV for non-differentiable regularizers under Gaussian covariates and strong convexity. Using a conditioning argument, the difference between the ALO-CV weights and their counterparts in mean-field inference is shown to be small. Combined with upper bounds between the mean-field inference estimate and the leave-one-out quantity, this provides a proof that ALO-CV approximates the leave-one-out quantity up to negligible error terms. Linear models with square loss, robust linear regression and single-index models are explicitly treated.

translated_title: 近似留一交叉验证与平均场推断的联合分析
translated_abstract: 近似留一交叉验证（ALO-CV）是一种被提出用于估计正则化估计量泛化误差的方法，适用于维度与样本量同阶的高维情形，即所谓的“成比例情形”。本文发展了一种新的分析方法，在高斯协变量与强凸性条件下，推导出了ALO-CV在不可微正则化子情形下的一致性。通过条件化论证，本文证明了ALO-CV权重与平均场推断中对应权重之间的差异很小。再结合平均场推断估计量与留一量之间的上界，本文证明了ALO-CV能够在误差项可忽略的范围内逼近真实的留一量。文中明确处理了带平方损失的线性模型、稳健线性回归以及单指标模型。
tldr: 本文通过将ALO-CV与平均场推断进行联合分析，在高斯协变量与强凸性条件下首次证明了近似留一交叉验证对于不可微正则化子也能以可忽略的误差一致地逼近真实的留一泛化误差。
en_tdlr: By simultaneously analyzing ALO-CV and mean-field inference, this paper proves that approximate leave-one-out cross-validation consistently approximates the leave-one-out generalization error up to negligible error for non-differentiable regularizers under Gaussian covariates and strong convexity.
